name: scrapingbee
description: Fetch any web page as text, markdown, HTML or a screenshot, extract structured data, and get JSON results from Google, Amazon, Walmart and YouTube with ScrapingBee
shortDescription: Web scraping, search and data extraction

setup.notice: JavaScript rendering and anti-bot protection are handled automatically; each call spends credits from your ScrapingBee plan.
steps: Create a ScrapingBee account and copy the API key from the dashboard
For batch jobs, site crawls and output to files, install the ScrapingBee CLI described in the skills
